name: Sugar Control LI4 Acupressure Hand Clip | Stress & Migraine Relief | Random Color
description:
Find natural relief with the Sugar Control LI4 Acupressure Hand Clip, designed to apply gentle pressure on the LI4 point between your thumb and index finger. This compact and lightweight clip helps reduce stress, ease tension, relieve migraines, and promote relaxation—all without drugs or side effects. Perfect for use at home, work, or on the go, it’s a safe and convenient solution for everyday wellness.
Key Features
 Lightweight & portable (only 6g) – use anytime, anywhere
 Drug-free & safe – supports stress, headache & migraine relief
 Easy to use – simply clip onto the LI4 pressure point
 Comfortable fit – designed for everyday wear
 Great gift idea – a thoughtful wellness accessory
How to Use
 Place the clip on the LI4 point (between thumb & index finger)
 Adjust for a snug but comfortable fit
 Wear during stress, headache, or tension for relief
Material
Durable ABS Plastic + Soft Grip
Safety Information
 Not recommended during pregnancy
 Keep out of reach of children
 Use only on the LI4 point for best results
 If discomfort occurs, remove immediately
